'''''Aechmea pineliana''''' is a [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Bromeliaceae]].<ref name=KewPOWO/> It is typical of [[Atlantic Forest]] [[vegetation]] in [[Brazil]], specially in following states: [[Espírito Santo]], [[Minas Gerais]], and [[Rio de Janeiro (state)|Rio de Janeiro]]. This plant is cited in [[Flora Brasiliensis]] by [[Carl Friedrich Philipp von Martius]], and it is often used as an [[ornamental plant]].
